note: Glass-batch material descriptor stage. Consumes Geant4-probed densities of the three raw materials and of the DECLARED product, plus silica electron density, and returns batch/product descriptors. It contains no reaction rate and no schedule. Hand-authored illustrative map: it demonstrates the mechanism (Geant4 material facts -> conditions -> per-material operators) and carries no measured training domain, no scale band and no held-out accuracy (measured:false, teacher:none). The declared input mean/std are the intended operating range, so a run far outside it is honestly flagged as extrapolating; they are NOT a measured hull. It must never be described as glass-making metrology.
